chunks.code: SELECT c.name, p.name AS product, oi.quantity
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
chunks.explain: Link each customer to their orders

chunks.code: JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
chunks.explain: Link each order to its line items

chunks.code: JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
chunks.explain: Link each line item to its product
